shots.focal_element: Floating app window (list view, then Planner calendar) on a magenta-orange-blue gradient backdrop
shots.what_happens: The rounded, drop-shadowed app window sits centred on a grainy gradient showing a grouped task list while VO says work flows 'without the context switching' (w55-w61); around 22.5-23.0 s the window content swaps with a horizontal motion blur to the Planner week calendar as VO introduces 'Calendar also gets a major upgrade' (w62-w67), and the cursor drags a backlog item into a 7 am slot, creating a time block.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a 1280x720 grainy diagonal gradient, place a ~70%-width rounded app-window screenshot with soft drop shadow centred, crossfade its content from the list screenshot to the calendar screenshot behind a 0.3 s horizontal motion blur, then animate a cursor dragging a card into a calendar cell.

shots.focal_element: Planner sidebar priorities list and the 7 am 'Work on Fall 2025' calendar block
on_screen_text: Work on Fall 2025 Brand Awareness Campaign Request
Time blocked in the next two weeks
shots.typography: Native product UI text: sans-serif (Inter-like, low confidence), regular/medium weight, sentence case, normal tracking; tooltips are small white-on-dark labels.
shots.what_happens: Camera is pushed in on the left half of the Planner: the cursor clicks the 7 am work block (it highlights solid blue) on 'Walk time for what matters most' (w71-w76), then moves to the 'Facebook retargeting' priority, hovers its icons revealing the 'Auto-schedule this task' and 'Time blocked in the next two weeks' tooltips on 'let AI auto-schedule' (w77-w80), and a new Facebook retargeting block appears below the work block.
shots.build_rebuild: Show a 2x-scaled crop of the Planner screenshot filling the frame, script a cursor path with click states on the calendar block, then reveal two small dark tooltips on hover and fade/scale in a new pink time block beneath the existing one.

shots.focal_element: 'AI suggestion' popover for Facebook retargeting with a dark 'Confirm work session' button
shots.typography: Product UI sans-serif (Inter-like, low confidence); popover title semibold sentence case, button label white medium weight on near-black pill, normal tracking.
shots.what_happens: Pulled back to the full window on the gradient: an AI-suggested dashed pink block (9:15-11:15) opens a detail popover; the cursor clicks 'Confirm work session' on 'your perfect day' (w82-w84), the popover closes and the block settles; as VO says 'Vacations, holidays' (w85-w86) the view motion-blurs and zooms toward the top-left create menu.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the window from ~110% to ~80% centred on the gradient, pop in a shadowed popover card next to the dashed block, animate a cursor click on its button, fade the popover out, then end with a 0.25 s scale-up plus motion blur toward the top-left corner.

shots.focal_element: Planner 'Create' dropdown menu with Event, Focus time, Out of office, Task
shots.typography: Product UI sans-serif (Inter-like, low confidence), regular weight menu items in sentence case, small grey 'Create' label, normal tracking.
shots.what_happens: Zoomed in on the top-left of the window with the gradient visible above: the cursor moves down the open Create menu from Event to 'Out of office' and clicks on 'non-working days' (w87-w89); the camera then pans right with motion blur to the weekend columns where an all-day 'Out of Office' bar now sits, landing as VO says 'it's all in here' (w90-w93).
shots.build_rebuild: Crop the window at ~2x around the create menu, move the cursor through the menu items with a hover highlight, then tween the crop's x-position right over ~0.4 s with horizontal motion blur to frame the new all-day bar.

shots.focal_element: 'Out of Office' event detail popover, then the Marketing Teams Hub page
on_screen_text: Declined because I am out of office
shots.typography: Product UI sans-serif (Inter-like, low confidence); popover title semibold sentence/title case, details regular weight, normal tracking.
shots.what_happens: Full window on the gradient with the Out of Office event selected and its popover showing auto-decline settings during 'so your plans finally reflect reality' (w94-w99); around 38.5 s a strong horizontal whip blur swaps the window content to the Marketing Teams Hub page as VO says 'And execution' (w100-w101).
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the centred shadowed window with the popover card for ~2.5 s, then translate the window content left by one width over ~0.3 s with heavy horizontal motion blur, revealing the next screenshot.

shots.focal_element: Spotlit tab bar of the Marketing Teams Hub (Overview through Timesheet)
on_screen_text: Overview Analytics Priorities Feed Team StandUp Workload Timesheet
Welcome to the Marketing Team Hub!
shots.typography: Product UI sans-serif (Inter-like, low confidence); tab labels medium weight title case with coloured icons; page heading bold sentence case; normal tracking.
shots.what_happens: Close-up on the Teams Hub page: the whole UI is dimmed except a white, soft-edged spotlight rectangle over the tab bar, held while VO says 'that's where Teams Hub comes in' (w102-w107); at the end the dim lifts and the view pulls back slightly with a cursor visible.
shots.build_rebuild: Show a ~2x crop of the hub page, overlay a 40% grey dim layer with a rounded-rectangle cut-out (soft feathered edge) around the tab bar, hold ~1.8 s, then fade the dim out while scaling the crop down ~10%.
